name: video_pika_h3_flex_t2v
title: Pika H3 Flex: Text to Video
summary: Generate a video with synchronized audio from a text prompt with Pika H3 Flex, a Pika post-trained adapter for MiniMax H3 that lands a finished 1344x768, 124-frame clip in six sampling steps. The adapter runs at strength 1.0 on the int8 MiniMax H3 base with the lcm sampler and Pika's own six-value sigma list, so a full render takes about a minute instead of a 20-step run. Ideal for fast prompt exploration and concept iteration on H3, with no image input to prepare.
